scenario.title: Beneficiary Management
scenario.description:
Test the bank application's beneficiary management feature.

The user should be able to:

Add a new beneficiary
Validate mandatory beneficiary details
Validate account number and IFSC format
Prevent duplicate beneficiaries
Edit beneficiary details
Delete an existing beneficiary
Handle OTP verification
Prevent transactions to an unapproved beneficiary
Handle invalid/expired OTP
Handle API/network failure during beneficiary operations
Verify beneficiary status and transaction eligibility

Expected focus: Functional, positive, negative, boundary, validation, security, and error-handling test cases.

reference_cases.title: Add a new beneficiary with all valid details
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and on the beneficiary management page
reference_cases.steps:
1. Click 'Add Beneficiary' button
2. Enter beneficiary name
3. Enter account number
4. Enter IFSC code
5. Select account type
6. Click 'Submit'
7. Enter OTP received
8. Click 'Verify'
reference_cases.test_data: name = 'Rajesh Kumar'; account_number = '1234567890123456'; ifsc = 'SBIN0001234'; account_type = 'Savings'; otp = '123456'
reference_cases.expected_result: Beneficiary is added successfully, confirmation message displayed 'Beneficiary added successfully', beneficiary appears in the list with status 'Pending Approval' or 'Active'

reference_cases.title: Add beneficiary without entering mandatory beneficiary name
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and on Add Beneficiary page
reference_cases.steps:
1. Leave beneficiary name field empty
2. Enter account number
3. Enter IFSC code
4. Click 'Submit'
reference_cases.expected_result: Error message displayed 'Beneficiary name is required' or similar, form is not submitted

reference_cases.title: Add beneficiary with invalid account number format - less than minimum digits
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and on Add Beneficiary page
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter beneficiary name
2. Enter account number with only 8 digits
3. Enter valid IFSC
4. Click 'Submit'
reference_cases.expected_result: Validation error displayed 'Account number must be between 9-18 digits' or similar, form not submitted

reference_cases.title: Add beneficiary with invalid account number - contains alphabets
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and on Add Beneficiary page
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter beneficiary name
2. Enter account number with alphabetic characters
3. Enter valid IFSC
4. Click 'Submit'
reference_cases.expected_result: Validation error 'Account number must contain only digits' displayed, form not submitted

reference_cases.title: Add beneficiary with invalid IFSC code format
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and on Add Beneficiary page
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter beneficiary name
2. Enter valid account number
3. Enter IFSC with incorrect format (less than 11 characters)
4. Click 'Submit'
reference_cases.expected_result: Error message 'Invalid IFSC code format. IFSC must be 11 characters' displayed, form not submitted

reference_cases.title: Attempt to add duplicate beneficiary with same account number
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in, beneficiary with account number '1234567890123456' already exists
reference_cases.steps:
1. Click 'Add Beneficiary'
2. Enter beneficiary details with existing account number
3. Click 'Submit'
reference_cases.expected_result: Error message 'Beneficiary with this account number already exists' displayed, duplicate not added

reference_cases.title: Edit existing beneficiary name
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in, beneficiary 'Rajesh Kumar' with account '1234567890123456' exists
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to beneficiary list
2. Click 'Edit' for the beneficiary
3. Change beneficiary name
4. Click 'Save'
5. Enter OTP
6. Click 'Verify'
reference_cases.test_data: old_name = 'Rajesh Kumar'; new_name = 'Rajesh K Kumar'; otp = '654321'
reference_cases.expected_result: Beneficiary name updated successfully, confirmation message displayed, updated name visible in beneficiary list

reference_cases.title: Delete an existing beneficiary
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in, beneficiary 'Test User' with account '9999888877776666' exists
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to beneficiary list
2. Click 'Delete' for the beneficiary
3. Confirm deletion in popup
4. Enter OTP
5. Click 'Verify'
reference_cases.expected_result: Beneficiary deleted successfully, confirmation message 'Beneficiary deleted' displayed, beneficiary no longer appears in list

reference_cases.title: Add beneficiary with incorrect OTP
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and has submitted beneficiary details
reference_cases.steps:
1. Fill all beneficiary details correctly
2. Click 'Submit'
3. Enter incorrect OTP
4. Click 'Verify'
reference_cases.expected_result: Error message 'Invalid OTP. Please try again' displayed, beneficiary not added, option to resend OTP available

reference_cases.title: Add beneficiary with expired OTP
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in, has submitted beneficiary details, OTP was sent 10 minutes ago
reference_cases.steps:
1. Fill beneficiary details
2. Click 'Submit'
3. Wait for OTP to expire (typically 5-10 minutes)
4. Enter the expired OTP
5. Click 'Verify'
reference_cases.expected_result: Error message 'OTP has expired. Please request a new OTP' displayed, beneficiary not added

reference_cases.title: Attempt transaction to unapproved beneficiary
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in, beneficiary exists with status 'Pending Approval'
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to fund transfer page
2. Select unapproved beneficiary
3. Enter amount
4. Click 'Transfer'
reference_cases.expected_result: Error message 'Cannot transfer to unapproved beneficiary. Please wait for approval' displayed, transaction blocked

reference_cases.title: Handle network failure during beneficiary addition
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in, network connection will be interrupted during submission
reference_cases.steps:
1. Fill all beneficiary details
2. Click 'Submit'
3. Simulate network disconnection before response
4. Observe behavior
reference_cases.expected_result: Error message 'Network error. Please check your connection and try again' displayed, or timeout message shown, beneficiary not added

reference_cases.title: Handle API failure during beneficiary deletion
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in, backend API returns 500 error
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to beneficiary list
2. Click 'Delete' for a beneficiary
3. Confirm deletion
4. Enter OTP
5. API returns error
reference_cases.expected_result: Error message 'Unable to delete beneficiary. Please try again later' or 'Service temporarily unavailable' displayed, beneficiary remains in list

reference_cases.title: Verify beneficiary status after successful addition
reference_cases.preconditions: User has just added a new beneficiary successfully
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to beneficiary list
2. Locate the newly added beneficiary
3. Check status field
reference_cases.expected_result: Beneficiary status shows 'Active' or 'Pending Approval' based on bank policy, status is clearly visible

reference_cases.title: Add beneficiary with maximum length account number
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and on Add Beneficiary page
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter beneficiary name
2. Enter 18-digit account number (maximum allowed)
3. Enter valid IFSC
4. Click 'Submit'
5. Enter OTP and verify
reference_cases.test_data: name = 'Max Length Test'; account_number = '123456789012345678' (18 digits); ifsc = 'BARB0001234'; otp = '333444'
reference_cases.expected_result: Beneficiary added successfully with 18-digit account number, no validation error

reference_cases.title: Add beneficiary with minimum length account number
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and on Add Beneficiary page
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter beneficiary name
2. Enter 9-digit account number (minimum allowed)
3. Enter valid IFSC
4. Click 'Submit'
5. Enter OTP and verify
reference_cases.test_data: name = 'Min Length Test'; account_number = '123456789' (9 digits); ifsc = 'UTIB0001234'; otp = '555666'
reference_cases.expected_result: Beneficiary added successfully with 9-digit account number, no validation error

reference_cases.title: Add beneficiary with account number exceeding maximum length
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and on Add Beneficiary page
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter beneficiary name
2. Enter 19-digit account number (exceeds maximum)
3. Enter valid IFSC
4. Click 'Submit'
reference_cases.test_data: name = 'Exceed Max Test'; account_number = '1234567890123456789' (19 digits); ifsc = 'CNRB0001234'
reference_cases.expected_result: Validation error 'Account number cannot exceed 18 digits' displayed, form not submitted

reference_cases.title: Add beneficiary with special characters in name
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and on Add Beneficiary page
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter beneficiary name with special characters
2. Enter valid account number
3. Enter valid IFSC
4. Click 'Submit'
reference_cases.expected_result: Either validation error 'Name can only contain letters and spaces' displayed, or special characters are stripped/sanitized and beneficiary added

reference_cases.title: Verify transaction eligibility for active beneficiary
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in, beneficiary with 'Active' status exists
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to fund transfer page
2. Select active beneficiary from dropdown
3. Verify beneficiary is selectable and transaction can proceed
reference_cases.expected_result: Active beneficiary is available in dropdown, can be selected, transaction form allows proceeding to next step

reference_cases.title: Add beneficiary with IFSC code containing lowercase letters
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and on Add Beneficiary page
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter beneficiary name
2. Enter valid account number
3. Enter IFSC code in lowercase
4. Click 'Submit'
reference_cases.expected_result: Either IFSC is auto-converted to uppercase and accepted, or validation error 'IFSC must be in uppercase' displayed

reference_cases.title: Cancel beneficiary addition after entering details
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and on Add Beneficiary page with partially filled form
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter beneficiary name
2. Enter account number
3. Click 'Cancel' or 'Back' button
4. Verify no data is saved
reference_cases.expected_result: User returned to beneficiary list page, no new beneficiary added, form data discarded

reference_cases.title: Resend OTP during beneficiary addition
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in, has submitted beneficiary details and is on OTP verification screen
reference_cases.steps:
1. Fill beneficiary details and submit
2. On OTP screen, click 'Resend OTP'
3. Wait for new OTP
4. Enter new OTP
5. Click 'Verify'
reference_cases.test_data: name = 'Resend OTP Test'; account_number = '3344556677889900'; ifsc = 'YESB0001234'; new_otp = '999888'
reference_cases.expected_result: New OTP sent successfully, message 'OTP resent successfully' displayed, beneficiary added with new OTP

reference_cases.title: Add beneficiary with very long name at boundary
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and on Add Beneficiary page
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter beneficiary name with maximum allowed characters (e.g., 100 chars)
2. Enter valid account number
3. Enter valid IFSC
4. Click 'Submit'
reference_cases.test_data: name = 'Abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz Abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz Abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz Abcdefghijklmnopqrst' (100 chars); account_number = '7766554433221100'; ifsc = 'FDRL0001234'
reference_cases.expected_result: Beneficiary added successfully with full name, or validation error if exceeds limit with specific character count mentioned

reference_cases.title: Edit beneficiary account number should be restricted
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in, beneficiary exists
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to beneficiary list
2. Click 'Edit' for a beneficiary
3. Attempt to modify account number field
reference_cases.expected_result: Account number field is disabled/read-only, cannot be edited, or error message 'Account number cannot be modified' displayed

reference_cases.title: Multiple OTP retry attempts should be limited
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and on OTP verification screen
reference_cases.steps:
1. Submit beneficiary details
2. Enter incorrect OTP
3. Repeat 3-5 times based on limit
4. Observe behavior after limit exceeded
reference_cases.expected_result: After maximum attempts (e.g., 3 or 5), error message 'Maximum OTP attempts exceeded. Please try after some time' displayed, further attempts blocked temporarily

helpers.name: setup
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Resets app to initial state: logged out, no current page, no visible message, restores starting beneficiary data (BEN001-BEN004), clears all OTP sessions, resets OTP attempt counters

helpers.name: teardown
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: If id provided, deletes the beneficiary with that ID. If id is None, does nothing. Used to clean up test-created data

helpers.name: open_page
helpers.returns: true if page opened, false if not allowed (e.g. not logged in)
helpers.behaviour: Opens the specified page. If not logged in and page is not 'Login', returns false and sets message 'Please log in to continue'. Otherwise sets current page and returns true

helpers.name: current_page
helpers.returns: string: current page name or empty string if none
helpers.behaviour: Returns the name of the currently displayed page

helpers.name: visible_message
helpers.returns: string: current message or empty string if none
helpers.behaviour: Returns the currently displayed message to the user

helpers.name: login
helpers.returns: true if login successful, false otherwise
helpers.behaviour: Attempts login with provided credentials. If email='testuser@bank.test' and password='Test@1234', logs in, opens Beneficiary List page, clears message, returns true. Otherwise sets message 'Invalid credentials' and returns false

helpers.name: click_button
helpers.returns: true if button exists and action performed, false otherwise
helpers.behaviour: Clicks the button with specified text on current page. 'Add Beneficiary' opens Add Beneficiary page. 'Submit' on Add Beneficiary validates and creates OTP session. 'Verify' on OTP Verification validates OTP. 'Save' on Edit Beneficiary validates and creates OTP session. 'Delete' creates OTP session for deletion. 'Cancel' returns to Beneficiary List. 'Resend OTP' generates new OTP. 'Transfer' on Fund Transfer validates beneficiary status. Returns false if button doesn't exist on current page

helpers.name: fill_field
helpers.returns: true if field exists, false otherwise
helpers.behaviour: Fills the specified field with value on current page. Fields: 'beneficiary_name', 'account_number', 'ifsc_code', 'account_type', 'otp', 'amount'. Returns false if field doesn't exist on current page

helpers.name: select_beneficiary
helpers.returns: true if beneficiary exists and selected, false otherwise
helpers.behaviour: On Fund Transfer page, selects beneficiary from dropdown. Returns false if beneficiary doesn't exist

helpers.name: click_edit
helpers.returns: true if beneficiary found and edit page opened, false otherwise
helpers.behaviour: On Beneficiary List page, clicks Edit for specified beneficiary. Opens Edit Beneficiary page with beneficiary data pre-filled. Account number field is read-only. Returns false if beneficiary not found

helpers.name: click_delete
helpers.returns: true if beneficiary found and delete initiated, false otherwise
helpers.behaviour: On Beneficiary List page, clicks Delete for specified beneficiary. Shows confirmation popup. If confirmed, creates OTP session for deletion and opens OTP Verification page with operation='delete'. Returns false if beneficiary not found

helpers.name: confirm_popup
helpers.returns: true
helpers.behaviour: Confirms the current popup dialog (e.g., delete confirmation)

helpers.name: get_beneficiary_list
helpers.returns: list of objects: [{name, account_number, ifsc, type, status}, ...]
helpers.behaviour: Returns list of all beneficiaries visible on Beneficiary List page. Only available when on Beneficiary List page, otherwise returns empty list

helpers.name: get_beneficiary_details
helpers.returns: object: {name, account_number, ifsc, type, status} or None if not found
helpers.behaviour: Returns details of specified beneficiary from the list on current page. Returns None if beneficiary not found or not on Beneficiary List page

helpers.name: simulate_network_failure
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Sets a flag that causes the next API operation to fail with network error. Next submit/verify will set message 'Network error. Please check your connection and try again' and return false

helpers.name: simulate_api_failure
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Sets a flag that causes the next API operation to fail with server error. Next operation will set message 'Unable to complete operation. Please try again later' and return false

helpers.name: add_beneficiary
helpers.returns: object: {ok: true, beneficiary_id, otp} or {ok: false, error}
helpers.behaviour: Validates inputs: name required (not empty), account_number must be 9-18 digits (only numbers), ifsc must be 11 characters (4 letters + 7 alphanumeric, uppercase), account_type must be 'Savings' or 'Current'. Checks for duplicate account_number. If valid and not duplicate, creates OTP session with otp='123456', operation='add', returns {ok: true, beneficiary_id: 'BENXXX', otp: '123456'}. If validation fails, returns {ok: false, error: 'specific error message'}. Beneficiary not actually added until OTP verified

helpers.name: verify_otp
helpers.returns: object: {ok: true} or {ok: false, error}
helpers.behaviour: Validates OTP for pending operation. Checks if OTP session exists for beneficiary_id and operation. If OTP matches and not expired (within 10 minutes) and attempts < 5, completes operation (adds/updates/deletes beneficiary with status 'Active'), clears OTP session, returns {ok: true}. If OTP incorrect, increments attempt counter, returns {ok: false, error: 'Invalid OTP. Please try again'}. If expired, returns {ok: false, error: 'OTP has expired. Please request a new OTP'}. If max attempts exceeded (5), returns {ok: false, error: 'Maximum OTP attempts exceeded. Please try after some time'}

helpers.name: update_beneficiary
helpers.returns: object: {ok: true, otp} or {ok: false, error}
helpers.behaviour: Validates name (required, not empty). Creates OTP session with otp='654321', operation='update', stores new name. Returns {ok: true, otp: '654321'}. Name not actually updated until OTP verified. Account number cannot be changed

helpers.name: delete_beneficiary
helpers.returns: object: {ok: true, otp} or {ok: false, error}
helpers.behaviour: Creates OTP session with otp='789012', operation='delete'. Returns {ok: true, otp: '789012'}. Beneficiary not actually deleted until OTP verified

helpers.name: resend_otp
helpers.returns: object: {ok: true, otp} or {ok: false, error}
helpers.behaviour: Generates new OTP for existing session. New otp='999888', resets expiry time and attempt counter. Returns {ok: true, otp: '999888'}

helpers.name: check_transaction_eligibility
helpers.returns: object: {ok: true, eligible: true/false, reason} or {ok: false, error}
helpers.behaviour: Checks if beneficiary can receive transfer. If status is 'Active', returns {ok: true, eligible: true}. If status is 'Pending Approval', returns {ok: true, eligible: false, reason: 'Cannot transfer to unapproved beneficiary. Please wait for approval'}. If beneficiary not found, returns {ok: false, error: 'Beneficiary not found'}

helpers.name: get_beneficiaries
helpers.returns: object: {ok: true, beneficiaries: [{id, name, account_number, ifsc, type, status}, ...]}
helpers.behaviour: Returns list of all beneficiaries for logged-in user

helpers.name: get_beneficiary
helpers.returns: object: {ok: true, beneficiary: {id, name, account_number, ifsc, type, status}} or {ok: false, error}
helpers.behaviour: Returns details of specified beneficiary. Returns {ok: false, error: 'Beneficiary not found'} if not found

helpers.name: db_get_beneficiary
helpers.returns: object: {id, name, account_number, ifsc, type, status, added_date} or None
helpers.behaviour: Returns beneficiary record from database by ID, or None if not found

helpers.name: db_get_beneficiary_by_account
helpers.returns: object: {id, name, account_number, ifsc, type, status, added_date} or None
helpers.behaviour: Returns beneficiary record from database by account number, or None if not found

helpers.name: db_get_all_beneficiaries
helpers.returns: list of objects: [{id, name, account_number, ifsc, type, status, added_date}, ...]
helpers.behaviour: Returns all beneficiary records from database

helpers.name: db_beneficiary_exists
helpers.returns: boolean: true if exists, false otherwise
helpers.behaviour: Checks if beneficiary with given account number exists in database

helpers.name: db_get_otp_session
helpers.returns: object: {beneficiary_id, otp, operation, created_time, attempts, data} or None
helpers.behaviour: Returns OTP session details from database, or None if no active session

helpers.name: db_count_beneficiaries
helpers.returns: integer: count of beneficiaries
helpers.behaviour: Returns total number of beneficiaries in database

rules: Beneficiary name is required (cannot be empty)
Account number must be 9-18 digits, containing only numeric characters
IFSC code must be exactly 11 characters: 4 uppercase letters followed by 7 alphanumeric characters
IFSC code in lowercase is rejected with validation error
Account type must be 'Savings' or 'Current'
Duplicate beneficiaries (same account number) are not allowed
Account number field is read-only during edit (cannot be modified)
All add/edit/delete operations require OTP verification
OTP is valid for 10 minutes from generation
Maximum 5 OTP verification attempts allowed per session
Incorrect OTP increments attempt counter but doesn't consume the OTP
After 5 failed attempts, user must wait before trying again
Resend OTP generates new OTP and resets attempt counter and expiry time
Beneficiaries can have status 'Active' or 'Pending Approval'
Transactions can only be made to beneficiaries with 'Active' status
Transactions to 'Pending Approval' beneficiaries are blocked
Network failures prevent operation completion and show error message
API failures prevent operation completion and show error message
Beneficiary name can contain letters, spaces, and periods, maximum 100 characters
Special characters in name (except spaces and periods) trigger validation error
Cancel operation discards all entered data and returns to beneficiary list

not_supported: Actual time-based OTP expiry: OTP expiry is simulated with a fixed timestamp check, not real-time clock
Actual OTP delivery mechanism: OTPs are returned directly in API responses for testing purposes
Real network calls: Network and API failures are simulated via test helper functions
Actual waiting period after max attempts: The blocking is immediate and permanent within a test session
Multiple user accounts: Only one test user account exists; beneficiaries are per-user but only one user is modeled
